text: I want to keep track of the books I've read, with a rating and a few notes on each.
A log of my runs: distance, time and how I felt afterwards.
Help me remember when I last watered each of my plants.
My recipes with ingredients and steps, and a page where friends can browse them.
Keep my car's service history and remind me when the next oil change is due.
Our three-person agency needs to follow up on leads and see which deals are close to signing.
A tool for our support team to log customer complaints and who is handling each one.
We rent out four holiday cottages and want guests to book their dates online.
Invoices for my freelance design work, with VAT and a PDF I can send to the client.
Our band wants a site listing upcoming gigs, with a page for each one.
Booking page for my hair salon where customers pick a stylist and a time.
A neighbourhood board where anyone can post things they're giving away for free.
A page showing whether our services are up, with past incidents.
Status page for the school's IT systems so teachers stop emailing us every time the wifi is down.
An inventory of our lab equipment that our other programs can query.
Let our support chatbot look up customers' orders and change the delivery address.
Meeting room booking for our office of thirty people.
A marketplace where local makers list handmade goods and buyers can message them.
Club members sign up for training sessions, at most twelve per session.
Keep track of who in the family owes whom after our trips.
Hiring pipeline: candidates, which stage they're at, and interview notes.
A job board where companies post openings and people apply.
Our sales team tracks accounts, contacts and when each contract comes up for renewal.
Billing for my cleaning business: clients, jobs done, and an invoice to each client every month.
A list of our internal tools and who owns each one, for everyone in the company.
A to-do list my AI assistant can read and add to while I work.
Volunteers sign up for shifts at our food bank, and coordinators see who is coming.
A public page of our cafe's menu that the staff can update.
Let people suggest feature ideas, vote on them, and see our roadmap.
Track the equipment our film crew lends out and when it's due back.
Something for my shop.
Appointment booking for my physio clinic with SMS reminders.
Sell tickets to our weekend workshops, paid through Stripe.
A CRM that syncs with our Gmail and logs every email automatically.
Track my expenses and also invoice my two clients each month.
A dashboard for our startup.
Uber for dog walkers, with live GPS tracking of each walk.
Stock for the cafe that reorders from our supplier by itself when something runs low.
A portal where our clients see their invoices and pay by card, and we track which are overdue.
A status page that checks our servers every minute and posts outages to Slack.
